user.title: Hoval CAN
user.description: Connect to your Hoval WLAN gateway (port 3113 CAN-BUS stream).

data_description.host: IP address of the Hoval WLAN gateway on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port of the CAN-BUS stream (default: 3113).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable on port 3113.
